_comment: Paths a doctor/health-check pass should confirm omp can actually read after `gen.js --target omp` runs. Sourced from spike S4-S5 (a) 'omp-native paths' + 'Claude Code compatibility provider' discovery tables — {home} is $PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR or ~/.omp/agent (task's --out), {claudeHome} is $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude, {userHome} is the OS home directory. omp reads the Claude/Codex paths on its own (skills/commands/CLAUDE.md), so this generator writes nothing for them and this list exists only so a probe can verify they are still readable, not to imply the generator owns them.
